title: HouseFly
tagline: Home search. Fixed forever using the power of verified IDs and private storage
description: Home search is broken. Fake listings, untrustworthy agencies and bots scraping and manipulating landscapes. HouseFly fixes this, by using an mini app that leverages verified IDs and private data storage. Privacy is ensured at both ends for the landlord as well as renter. Plus it doesnt let AI scrape listings.
how_its_made:
HouseFly is a World Mini app. It uses World ID to verify if the listings are not botted, as well as who is behind the listing. 
The listing is stored via Akave and we use an MCP using local LLM to ensure that listings are not scraped by bots as well as maintains both the host and guest privacy.
